Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Portal activation accepts but login stalls

Hi Grace,

We tried the supplier activation flow for Norstar this morning (Coupa onboarding). The activation link in the initial invite appears to accept — we get the green confirmation page — but when we attempt to sign in immediately afterward the portal hangs on a "Processing..." spinner and never lands on the vendor dashboard. We've tested in Chrome 112 and Edge 105.

Steps we took:
- Click activation link (token appears valid) — server returns 200 confirmation.
- Attempt sign-in via SSO (Okta) — redirect to Coupa, shows spinner for >2 minutes then times out.
- Tried on mobile (Safari) same behavior.
- Cleared cookies and retried once with same result.

Attached: screenshot of the spinner state and the acceptance confirmation page.

We need to complete onboarding so we can receive PO creation instructions and submit W-9. Can you advise next steps or what logs you need?

Thanks,
Jamie Ortega
Procurement Lead — Norstar Manufacturing

Hi Jamie — thanks for the clear steps, good repro notes.

Ben / Marissa — looping you in. This looks like an SSO handoff problem during the post-acceptance redirect. Ben, can you review Coupa + Okta assertions for Norstar and check whether RelayState or a very large assertion is being rejected by the gateway? If useful, open a support ticket JIRA SUP-5238 and drop the request id there.

Jamie — a couple quick asks that will help narrow it down:
- Can you capture the browser network/request that occurs immediately after the green confirmation (the SAML POST or redirect)? If you can paste the SAML RequestID and the timestamp (UTC) here that would be helpful.
- Try signing in with a private/incognito window (helps rule out cookie reuse).
- If possible, send the exact email address you used to accept the invite and the name on the vendor account (we can look for that acceptance event in our audit logs).

We won't touch your tenant config without your sign-off; Ben will propose a short remediation plan if we see a gateway mismatch.

I'll keep this thread as the primary log.

Thanks — reproduced locally against a test Norstar invite and pulled logs. Quick technical summary:

Observations:
- The acceptance token is processed successfully and we emit the acceptance event in the audit log.
- Immediately after acceptance the browser is redirected to a POST to Coupa's SSO endpoint with RelayState populated (RelayState contains a redirect URL + ephemeral session data).
- In Norstar's case the RelayState blob is ~1.4KB (URL + metadata). Our gateway parses RelayState and hands off to the session store. When RelayState is above a threshold we've seen a race where the session cookie isn't set before the final redirect, leaving the browser on a spinner waiting for session init.

Workaround (safe short-term):
- Try the activation again in an incognito/private window (this avoids stale cookies).
- If that fails, please try removing any query params from the acceptance redirect (we can issue a shortened RelayState token if needed).

I've attached a snippet of the server logs showing the acceptance event and the subsequent SSO handoff with the RelayState size indicator.

Planned fix: we will add a small gating check to ensure the Set-Cookie is applied before the final redirect (low-risk server change). I filed internal JIRA SUP-5238 to track the fix and will update here when the patch is scheduled (ETA: next maintenance window).

Ben
